body.intent: Inbox app: pick an inbox item and do its one action (answer a question or gate, sign off a run, retry or abandon a failed run), then close; rebuilt on the modal shell over the inbox, question.answer, run.approve, run.resume and run.abandon operations, replacing internal/tui/inboxapp and retiring the capabilities of the old inbox app it replaces
body.title: Inbox app on the modal shell
